name: tf-apply-guard
description: Intercepts terraform apply/destroy in Bash and asks for approval, with a distinct confirmation for production.

prodKeywords.description: Comma-separated words that mark a command as production (whole words, case-insensitive).

stagingKeywords.description: Comma-separated words that mark a command as staging/non-prod.

stagingPolicy.description: What to do for a staging command: ask for approval, or allow it and just log.

unknownPolicy.description: What to do when the environment can't be told from the command.

blockAutoApprove.description: Deny any watched command carrying -auto-approve outright, without asking.
blockAutoApprove.title: Block -auto-approve
